Hi Samantha / Devon —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a shared view for the MAP: 

Summary of decisions from the call
- Pilot scope: 3 primary workflows (scheduling reminders, intake triage, claim status messages)
- Success criteria: 95% critical-path reliability during weekday peak; latency under 650ms for 95th pct
- Target close & kickoff: aiming to sign and start onboarding week of Aug 24 (target close Aug 21)

Draft MAP milestones (attached as AtlasCare_MAP_v0.3.xlsx)
1) Security & compliance review — owner: AtlasCare (Procurement) — due Jul 28 (dependency: completed SOC2 questionnaire)
2) Pilot contract & SOW finalization — owner: Redwood (Neha + Legal) / AtlasCare (Procurement) — due Aug 7
3) Technical validation (sample dataset run) — owner: Marcus Lin — due Aug 14 (dependency: dataset & safe-sanitization plan)
4) Production readiness checklist & rollout plan — owner: Monica Patel — due Aug 20

Immediate asks
- Samantha / Procurement: please confirm who will own the SOC2 questionnaire and whether you need our redacted logs sample by Friday Jul 23.
- Devon: can you confirm the dataset export cadence and whether PII will be deidentified before transfer?
- Marcus/Monica: if there are any timeline issues with the validation or rollout tasks, flag now so we can adjust the target close.

I attached v0.3 of the MAP with owners and dates. I’ll ping weekly (Thursdays) for a short checkpoint unless you prefer a different cadence.

Best,
